A: 12, 14, 18, 12, 5, 5
B: 13, 1, 7, 9, 12, 18
C: 8, 6, 4, 6, 9, 15
D: 15, 15, 21, 15, 8, 6
E: 15, 13, 21, 15, 8, 10

Rules: every robot must select exactly one goal. Each goal must be selected by exactly one robot. Robot paths visualize assignment costs only; collisions and travel timing are not part of this game.
